verdict.rationale: Linear's own editor handles rich content in issues, comments and documents. It supports collapsible sections (a component-like block), media embeds on requests, and list formatting that survives paste, so formatting long-form content inside Linear documents is plausible. Nothing in the evidence describes a rich text editor built for publishing changelog or help content, or support for custom/extensible components beyond these built-in blocks. Missing for 10: custom or extensible editor components, documented changelog/help-content authoring or publishing workflow, broader editor formatting documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can use a rich text editor with custom components to format changelog and help content

citations.quote: For collapsible sections in an issue, comment, or document, use `+++ [some section title]` to start the section and `+++` to end it.
This request can be edited in Linear to add images, videos, or extra context.
Copying a list and pasting it as plain text now keeps the list numbers and bullets
